Backed by new funding from Goodwater Capital, Halo Glasses pioneer the new category of adaptive gaming, with a privacy-first, open-source architecture.

Brilliant Labs today announced the launch of Halo Glasses, a new generation of privacy-first smartglasses. Built on the belief that the most personalized experiences begin with trust, Halo Glasses feature an open-source architecture with on-device processing at its core, giving users greater control over their data while enabling experiences that are more personalized, helpful, and private.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261027712724/en/

That foundation powers an entirely new kind of experience. Halo Glasses introduce Narrative, a new category of adaptive gaming that transforms the real world into an open-world game that continuously evolves with each player so that everything you see, do, and explore becomes part of the experience. Narrative responds to your actions, decisions, and discoveries in real time, creating a personalized gaming experience that adapts endlessly.

"The future of intelligent wearables starts with trust," said Bobak Tavangar, CEO of Brilliant Labs. "Halo Glasses are built to protect that trust while using intelligence to help people engage more deeply and playfully with the world around them."

Private, Adaptive AI Enables an Entirely New Kind of Experience

At the heart of Halo Glasses is Noa, a personal AI companion that builds long-term memory around what matters to each user, learns from patterns over time, and responds conversationally in real time. Rather than resetting with every interaction, Noa carries context forward, allowing ideas, progress, relationships, and play to compound naturally. The result is an experience that becomes more personalized and engaging each time you interact with it.

Halo Glasses are built around three core experiences:

  • Ask. Talk to Noa naturally, like a personal AI assistant that’s always with you. Ask questions, explore ideas, and get context in the moment. Memory carries forward, so conversations build, preferences are remembered, and interactions pick up where you left off.
  • Make. Build mini-apps and custom workflows using just your voice, sharing what you make with the Halo community on its App Store. Describe what you want, and ideas take shape in real time. Creation feels immediate and flexible, without needing code or technical setup.
  • Play. Halo Glasses' flagship game experience, Narrative, turns everyday moments into the game of life, where ordinary moments become opportunities for discovery, collaboration, and play. The game evolves as you do, shaped by your choices, ideas, and actions over time.

A New Kind of Game Requires a New Kind of Hardware

Built as a modern, all-day wearable, Halo Glasses function as the console for Narrative, featuring a full-color microOLED display, microphones, bone conduction speakers, optical-grade lenses, Bluetooth 5.3, on-device AI, and up to 14 hours of battery life. Weighing just over 40 grams and engineered for balance and comfort, Halo Glasses are designed for continuous, real-world wear.

Halo Glasses are built with a privacy-first architecture anchored by on-device processing. Core functionality runs locally whenever possible, minimizing reliance on the cloud while giving users greater control over their data and personal context.

That same privacy-first approach extends to how Halo sees the world. Its low-resolution image sensor gives Halo visual context without functioning as a traditional camera for photography or video. Think of it as visual note-taking: Halo can see, understand, and remember what you see, while the images themselves are processed privately on-device, immediately discarded, and never stored.

Brilliant Labs designs and manufactures Halo Glasses from the ground up as a fully integrated system spanning industrial design, sensors, battery performance, and system intelligence. A custom AI stack combines real-time conversational intelligence, long-term memory, and dynamic tool creation, allowing hardware and software to operate together while preserving user privacy.

Built on a fully open-source hardware and software foundation, Halo Glasses and their AI companion Noa invite developers, creators, and the broader community to extend, remix, and shape the platform over time in a transparent, privacy-first way. Rather than being dictated by a single studio or static design, the platform evolves alongside its users.

Availability and Pricing

Halo Glasses officially launch on October 27, 2026. Priced at $399 they are available now at brilliant.xyz.

Brilliant Labs is backed by leading investors including Goodwater Capital, with participation from Brendan Iribe and other notable partners. Together, they support Brilliant Labs' long-term vision for private, open wearables that deepen how people experience and engage with the world.

With Halo Glasses, Brilliant Labs is defining a new point of view for intelligent wearables while pioneering an entirely new kind of smart game experience that redefines how people experience play, creativity, and discovery in everyday life.

ABOUT BRILLIANT LABS

Brilliant Labs is an integrated AI hardware and software company pioneering a new category of intelligent wearables designed for play in the real world. Founded in 2019, Brilliant Labs combines custom-designed hardware with open-source, privacy-first artificial intelligence to create experiences that evolve alongside their users, transforming everyday life into a living, playable system. Backed by leading investors including Goodwater Capital, with participation from Brendan Iribe and other notable partners, Brilliant Labs is advancing a distinct vision for AI wearables centered on creativity, curiosity, and human-centered play. Learn more at brilliant.xyz.

ⓘ 本文为第三方内容，不代表本站观点。我们不保证其准确性或完整性。

在 Goodwater Capital 新一轮资金的支持下，Halo Glasses 以隐私优先的开源架构，开创自适应游戏这一全新品类。

Brilliant Labs 今日宣布推出 Halo Glasses，这是一款隐私优先的新一代智能眼镜。Halo Glasses 秉持最个性化的体验始于信任这一理念，采用以设备端处理为核心的开源架构，让用户更好地掌控自己的数据，同时提供更个性化、更实用、隐私保护更完善的体验。

本新闻稿包含多媒体内容。点击此处查看完整新闻稿：https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261027712724/en/

这一基础支撑起了一种全新的体验。Halo Glasses 推出 Narrative，开创自适应游戏这一全新品类，将现实世界变为一个随每位玩家不断演变的开放世界游戏，让你所见、所做和探索的一切都成为体验的一部分。Narrative 会实时响应你的行动、决定和发现，创造出不断自适应的个性化游戏体验。

Brilliant Labs 首席执行官 Bobak Tavangar 表示：“智能可穿戴设备的未来始于信任。Halo Glasses 旨在守护这份信任，同时借助智能技术，帮助人们以更深入、更富趣味的方式与周围世界互动。”

注重隐私的自适应 AI 带来全新体验

Halo Glasses 的核心是个人 AI 伙伴 Noa。它围绕每位用户重视的事物建立长期记忆，随着时间推移从各种规律中学习，并以对话方式实时回应。Noa 不会在每次互动时重新开始，而是延续上下文，让想法、进展、人际关系和游玩体验自然积累。因此，每次与它互动，体验都会变得更加个性化、更有吸引力。

Halo Glasses 围绕三种核心体验打造：

  • 提问。自然地与 Noa 交谈，就像与一位始终陪伴你的个人 AI 助手交流。提出问题、探索想法，并即时获取相关背景信息。记忆会延续，因此对话可以不断深入，偏好会被记住，互动也能从上次结束的地方继续。
  • 创作。仅用语音即可构建迷你应用和自定义工作流程，并通过 Halo 社区的 App Store 分享你的作品。描述你的需求，想法便会实时成形。创作过程即时而灵活，无需编写代码或进行技术配置。
  • 游玩。Halo Glasses 的旗舰游戏体验 Narrative 将日常时刻变成人生游戏，让平凡时刻成为发现、协作和游玩的契机。游戏与你一同演变，随着时间推移，由你的选择、想法和行动塑造。

全新的游戏需要全新的硬件

Halo Glasses 是一款适合全天佩戴的现代可穿戴设备，作为 Narrative 的游戏主机，配备全彩 microOLED 显示屏、麦克风、骨传导扬声器、光学级镜片、蓝牙 5.3、设备端 AI，以及最长 14 小时的电池续航。Halo Glasses 重量略超 40 克，在设计上注重平衡与舒适，适合在现实生活中持续佩戴。

Halo Glasses 采用以设备端处理为基础的隐私优先架构。核心功能尽可能在本地运行，最大限度减少对云端的依赖，同时让用户更好地掌控自己的数据和个人情境信息。

同样的隐私优先理念也延伸到了 Halo 观察世界的方式。其低分辨率图像传感器为 Halo 提供视觉情境信息，但不会像传统相机那样用于拍照或录像。可以将其理解为视觉笔记：Halo 能够看见、理解并记住你所见的事物，而图像本身则在设备端以保护隐私的方式处理，随后立即丢弃，绝不存储。

Brilliant Labs 从零开始设计并制造 Halo Glasses，将工业设计、传感器、电池性能和系统智能整合为一个完整系统。定制的 AI 技术栈融合实时对话智能、长期记忆和动态工具创建能力，让硬件与软件协同运行，同时保护用户隐私。

Halo Glasses 及其 AI 伙伴 Noa 建立在完全开源的软硬件基础之上，邀请开发者、创作者和更广泛的社区，以透明、隐私优先的方式，持续扩展、重组和塑造这一平台。平台并非由单一工作室或固定设计所决定，而是与用户一同演进。

上市时间与价格

Halo Glasses 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日正式上市，售价 399 美元，现已在 brilliant.xyz 发售。

Brilliant Labs 获得了包括 Goodwater Capital 在内的领先投资者支持，Brendan Iribe 及其他知名合作伙伴也参与其中。他们共同支持 Brilliant Labs 的长期愿景：打造注重隐私、开放的可穿戴设备，加深人们体验世界并与之互动的方式。

通过 Halo Glasses，Brilliant Labs 正在为智能可穿戴设备确立全新视角，同时开创一种全新的智能游戏体验，重新定义人们在日常生活中体验游玩、创意和发现的方式。

关于 BRILLIANT LABS

Brilliant Labs 是一家集 AI 硬件与软件于一体的公司，致力于开创面向现实世界游玩的智能可穿戴设备新品类。Brilliant Labs 成立于 2019 年，将定制设计的硬件与开源、隐私优先的人工智能相结合，创造与用户一同演进的体验，将日常生活转变为一个鲜活、可游玩的系统。在包括 Goodwater Capital 在内的领先投资者支持下，以及 Brendan Iribe 和其他知名合作伙伴的参与下，Brilliant Labs 正在推进一种以创造力、好奇心和以人为本的游玩体验为核心的独特 AI 可穿戴设备愿景。更多信息请访问 brilliant.xyz。
